title: Vintage 1989 Budweiser Clydesdales Winter Pilsner Glass - Used
descriptionText: This vintage 1989 Budweiser tall pilsner beer glass is a must-have for any collector of breweriana. Featuring the iconic Budweiser logo and a winter wonderland scene with Clydesales, this glass is perfect for adding a touch of nostalgia to your drinkware collection. Made in the US, this glass is a true gem for any beer enthusiast. Whether you're using it to enjoy your favorite brew or displaying it as a decorative piece, this glass is sure to bring a touch of vintage charm to any space.
